final: SELECT p.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total, SUM(p.amount) / (SELECT SUM(p2.amount) FROM payment p2 JOIN rental r2 ON r2.rental_id = p2.rental_id) AS share_of_total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY p.staff_id HAVING SUM(p.amount) IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT SUM(p2.amount) FROM payment p2 JOIN rental r2 ON r2.rental_id = p2.rental_id) IS NOT NULL
